label: Diagram 1.2
caption: Diagram 1.2 Minimum ventilation rate for kitchen extract where a cooker hood does not extract to the outside(1)
description: The drawing is a schematic elevation of a kitchen. A rectangular room outline encloses the scene. Suspended from the top centre is a pyramid‑shaped cooker hood attached to a vertical duct running up to the ceiling. Wavy lines, representing air, emerge from both slanted sides of the hood, and further wavy lines rise from the top of a cooker set below it. The cooker is drawn as a box with two hobs, a front control panel showing circles and a rectangle, and a rectangular oven door. In the upper right corner, wavy lines point towards a crossed symbol, labelled "60 litres per second" on its left and "Outside" on its right. A note at the bottom left reads: "NOTE: 1. The diagram includes a recirculating cooker hood for illustration. A recirculating cooker hood on its own does not provide a means of ventilation that complies with Part F of the Building Regulations." The green title band states: "Diagram 1.2 Minimum ventilation rate for kitchen extract where a cooker hood does not extract to the outside(1)".
